title: PostgreSQL: Foreign Runtime/libpq is the primary native proving ground
summary: The PostgreSQL primary backend uses Foreign Runtime to own libpq connection/result handles and projects PGresult into the provider-neutral structured result model. The process/psql route remains an explicit fallback. v0.2 does not yet claim parameter-array marshalling, cancellation, nonblocking dispatch, COPY streaming or pipeline mode.
invariants: libpq native handles have explicit ownership and cleanup semantics.
The process route is a separate fallback implementation of the same upper contract.
No SQL interpolation fallback is allowed for the future parameter-binding implementation.
COPY requires explicit source/sink/backpressure/lifetime semantics rather than whole-result materialization.
Pipeline mode is only claimed when the linked libpq version and qualification prove it.

provenance.claim: PostgreSQL Foreign Runtime/libpq is primary; process is fallback; parameter arrays, cancellation, async, COPY streaming and pipeline are deliberate non-claims.
The continuation plan orders parameter binding, cancellation, nonblocking execution, COPY streaming and pipeline mode before later backends.
